accounts_help: Enter remembered account names as shown in the NetEase login dropdown, one per line. Use masked phone numbers or full email addresses. Optional OCR aliases: account#alias1#alias2. Enter a single line to switch to one account.
apple_or_android_help: Enabled selects Android; disabled selects iOS. Applies to every account.
auto_jade_help: Used only when the daily routine is disabled. The daily routine handles its one-cooperation-per-period quota automatically.
account_switch_invite_friend_name_help: Same-server main character nickname. Routine mode falls back to Wanted Quests, then 5791. The main must be online and accept the invitation.
account_routine_enable_help: Run two daily windows: daytime jade cooperation only; evening daily chores, one shared jade cooperation, then solo awakening for every alt.
account_daytime_run_time_help: Default 17:00, between 06:00 and 18:00. Stop checking alts once one jade cooperation is sent and completed for this refresh period.
account_evening_run_time_help: Default 20:00, after 18:00. Each alt runs daily chores, jade if still needed, then awakening.
account_awakening_layer_help: Layers 1 to 10; default 1. Solo battles with no team invitation.
account_awakening_count_help: Default 14 settled wins. Interrupted runs resume the remaining wins. No extra daily or achievement reward collection.
account_retry_minutes_help: Default 10 minutes. Resume unfinished steps without carrying a jade retry across its refresh boundary.
account_daily_courtyard_affairs_help: Run courtyard affairs during the evening routine with per-account checkpoints.
account_daily_pickup_email_help: Collect mail during the evening routine; skip accounts already done.
